signature: SUBROUTINE DLAEIN( RIGHTV, NOINIT, N, H, LDH, WR, WI, VR, VI, B,

params.name: rightv
params.reference: = .TRUE. : compute right eigenvector; = .FALSE.: compute left eigenvector.

params.name: noinit
params.reference: = .TRUE. : no initial vector supplied in (`VR`,`VI`). = .FALSE.: initial vector supplied in (`VR`,`VI`).

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix H. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ldh
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array H. $\mathrm{LDH} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: wi
params.reference: The real and imaginary parts of the eigenvalue of H whose corresponding right or left eigenvector is to be computed.

params.name: VI
params.reference: On entry, if `NOINIT` = .FALSE. and `WI = 0.0`, `VR` must contain a real starting vector for inverse iteration using the real eigenvalue `WR`; if `NOINIT` = .FALSE. and $\mathrm{WI} \ne 0.0$, `VR` and `VI` must contain the real and imaginary parts of a complex starting vector for inverse iteration using the complex eigenvalue (`WR`,`WI`); otherwise `VR` and `VI` need not be set. On exit, if `WI = 0.0` (real eigenvalue), `VR` contains the computed real eigenvector; if $\mathrm{WI} \ne 0.0$ (complex eigenvalue), `VR` and `VI` contain the real and imaginary parts of the computed complex eigenvector. The eigenvector is normalized so that the component of largest magnitude has magnitude 1; here the magnitude of a complex number (x,y) is taken to be \|x\| + \|y\|. `VI` is not referenced if `WI = 0.0`.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge N+1$.

params.name: eps3
params.reference: A small machine-dependent value which is used to perturb close eigenvalues, and to replace zero pivots.

params.name: smlnum
params.reference: A machine-dependent value close to the underflow threshold.

params.name: bignum
params.reference: A machine-dependent value close to the overflow threshold.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `= 1`: inverse iteration did not converge; `VR` is set to the last iterate, and so is `VI` if $\mathrm{WI} \ne 0.0$.
